text.title: Junior Next Pr Checklist Template Decision Tree
text.summary: Routing tree mapping observable review signals to a rule from `content/01-core-rules.xml`. Every leaf names either a concrete rule id or `skip-this-methodology` when the case is out of scope. Max depth = 4.

decision-tree.root-question: Was a PR review just completed with a junior author and at least one substantive review comment (not only nits a formatter would catch)?

conclusion.verdict: skip-this-methodology: no mentoring review to derive items from; automation-only feedback belongs in lint config, not a checklist

branch.question: Does a previous checklist exist for this junior?
Was every item on it ticked by the junior before review, and are any items carried three times or ticked on two consecutive PRs?

conclusion.verdict: retire mastered items, escalate thrice-carried ones to a pairing session, then draft the new list from this review's comments
draft the next list: each new item permalinked to a review comment, statuses set, 3 to 7 items, one blocker at most

branch.question: Are most of the review comments things a linter, formatter or type checker could enforce?

conclusion.verdict: file the lint/CI rules first; build the checklist only from the comments that need human judgement
run the procedure: permalinked, verifiable, standard-cited items, ordered by severity with at most one blocker

text.example: Observable: junior's PR reviewed with 9 comments; previous checklist exists; two items ticked twice in a row, one item carried three times → r-carry-forward-and-retire: retire the two, schedule pairing for the third, then draft 5 new permalinked items with one blocker.
